## Design

### 2026-10-05 — I started by making the schematic and wiring everything together all the connections, the nets, everything joined up in one logical diagram.![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-

**2h**

I started by making the schematic and wiring everything together all the connections, the nets, everything joined up in one logical diagram.![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/BHVSotWnbG2fhKlROyX6D3uJ45kKD2Lz/b1080c3d4263d4bb631a58a61f3892b996c3070be107c165307f9fd2d2fa075f.png)
the PCB. I took all those footprints and placed them physically, got them arranged where I wanted, and then routed the traces to match the connections I'd already defined. Finally I double checked that everything was placed and routed correctly before calling it done.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/BHVSotWnbG2fhKlROyX6D3uJ45kKD2Lz/8f01484ebcf66518ea3f4d92cc69047e91d01c501d920c14e01c7bb081e874c0.png)And on top of all that, I'm also thinking about making it portable. adding a battery so I can take it around without plugging in. That's the part I'm still figuring out, but that's the direction I want to go.

**2h**

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/BHVSotWnbG2fhKlROyX6D3uJ45kKD2Lz/c7f07918092678cf47001bec62d2a7f5890d940aef7574b7f7a19e6aa27b453f.png)Today the project took a complete turn, and for a good reason: I realized I didn't want an accessory, I wanted a pet.
